description: This file defines a Java interface 'CustomerFacade' which acts as a bridge between the CustomerService and controller layers in a web application. It outlines method signatures for customer data retrieval, merging shopping carts, registration, address management, authentication, and model population related to customers in the sales management system.

classes.name: CustomerFacade
classes.description: A Java interface providing method signatures for customer-related operations, acting as a bridge between service and controller layers in the application.

methods.name: getCustomerDataByUserName
methods.description: Fetches customer data based on username and store information.

methods.name: getCustomerById
methods.description: Retrieves customer details by customer ID.

methods.name: mergeCart
methods.description: Merges the customer's shopping cart with the session cart during authentication, and converts customer data into a CustomerEntity.

methods.name: getCustomerByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves customer information based on username and store.

methods.name: checkIfUserExists
methods.description: Checks if a user exists by username within a specific store.

methods.name: registerCustomer
methods.description: Registers a new customer with provided customer data, store, and language.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves a customer's address based on user ID and address type.

methods.name: setCustomerModelDefaultProperties
methods.description: Sets default properties on a Customer model related to the store.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a customer using username and password.

methods.name: getCustomerModel
methods.description: Creates a Customer model from a PersistableCustomer.

methods.name: populateCustomerModel
methods.description: Populates an existing Customer model with data from PersistableCustomer.
